**Write surface.** No write operation for the panel, the fee schedule or the service levels is published in the Ownership Map; the panel is held as versioned data and the two reads of section 12.1 are its surface (GAP-3109). Each error status of the reads is bound to a message: 401 is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-3109); 403 is MSG-P4-002 (X2); 503 is the platform 503 envelope (X4).
